theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_pfi_c1_lipschitz_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (K O : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsCompact K → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → ∃ (g : Euclid P → Euclid P) (L : NNReal), ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ LipschitzWith L g ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, g x = f x ∧ fderiv ℝ g x = fderiv ℝ f x
